text: MiCOM Agile P441, P442 & P444 | GE Vernova | Electrification

Part of the MiCOM P40 platform, the Agile P441, P442 and P444 numerical full scheme distance relays provide flexible, fast and reliable protection of transmission and sub-transmission lines. They include full scheme 6-zone distance, plus aided directional earth fault (DEF) and comprehensive backup protection for utility lines and cables at all voltage levels, particularly oriented towards transmission grids.
heading: Distance Protection Relays

text: These distance protection systems are ideal for single circuit breaker application, single and/or 3-pole tripping, and includes a full suite of monitoring, control and recording capabilities plus fault locator, autoreclose and check synchronism.
heading: Distance Protection Relays

text: Refurbishment Solutions – “If It’s Blue Think to Renew”

GE Vernova\’s latest MiCOM P440 series models P441 to P444 inclusive offer an ideal path to refurbish an older installed base of MiCOM P440 relays. Whether those older products were initially sold as GE VERNOVA or AREVA-branded products, newer models retain pin-pin refurbishment capability. Advantageously, users can benefit from the advancements made in protection, control, communications, hardware and cybersecurity that have taken place in the intervening years. The new P40 retains form, fit and function compatibility but delivers the latest platform and software ready for today\’s environment, and for future-proofed application for the decades ahead.
heading: Refurbishment Solutions – “If It’s Blue Think to Renew”

text: Take the order code (CORTEC) of the older relay being removed, typically a blue case relay

text: Translate to today\’s latest GE Vernova MiCOM model, adding Ethernet options if required
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Extract settings and logic, use S1 Agile toolsuite to convert settings
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Detach the terminal blocks from old relay, leaving wiring attached / detach terminal blocks from the new.
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Carefully examine the terminal blocks to see that no physical damage has occurred since installation
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Mount new relay. Old relay blocks fit straight onto the new relay - safer, less wiring to reconnect.
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: It is recommended to apply rated current and voltage to the relay CT/VT inputs during secondary injection testing to check the continuity of the CT/VT terminal block connections to the relay.
